label: token right after b, at step 4-5, in sequences starting with 2
explanation: Very sparse feature (about 0.0025% of steps). Fires almost only in the original phase at steps 4-5 (93% of mass), on the token right after a b (prev_tok=b holds 85% of mass), in sequences whose first token is 2 (89% of mass); typical context is 2 x y b [*]. It is stronger when the current input is h (top examples 2 p j f b [h], 2 f m b [h]) and when 1, j or f came earlier. Never fires in the copy phase; there are only a few weak hits on <DEL>. The core conjunction (first=2, prev=b, t in 4-5) gets 68% of mass but only 10% precision: most such steps stay silent, so the trigger depends on more of the prefix than these variables capture. Requiring 1, j or f in the prefix raises precision to about 30% (dev F1 0.36, mass recall 0.52). The magnitude claims are based on examples only.
